results.question: Show me Zenovax market share for my territory
results.sql:
WITH num AS (
SELECT z.territory_name AS dim0_id, z.territory_name AS dim0_label, SUM(s.pack_units * p.unit_conversion_factor) AS value
FROM sales s
JOIN organizations o ON o.org_id = s.org_id

results.question: Which accounts grew the most versus the prior quarter?

plan.interpretation: Interpreting 'last quarter' as the rolling 3 months (offsets 1,2,3) and 'prior quarter' as the preceding 3 months (offsets 4,5,6). Ranking by volume growth to find accounts that grew the most.

results.sql:
WITH cur AS (
SELECT COALESCE(o.grandparent_org_id, o.org_id) AS dim0_id, COALESCE(o.grandparent_org_name, o.org_name) AS dim0_label, SUM(s.pack_units) AS value
FROM sales s
JOIN organizations o ON o.org_id = s.org_id
WHERE s.data_source = ANY(%s) AND s.brand_flag = 1 AND s.mo_offset = ANY(%s)
GROUP BY COALESCE(o.grandparent_org_id, o.org_id), COALESCE(o.grandparent_org_name, o.org_name)
), pri AS (
SELECT COALESCE(o.grandparent_org_id, o.org_id) AS dim0_id, COALESCE(o.grandparent_org_name, o.org_name) AS dim0_label, SUM(s.pack_units) AS value
FROM sales s
JOIN organizations o ON o.org_id = s.org_id
WHERE s.data_source = ANY(%s) AND s.brand_flag = 1 AND s.mo_offset = ANY(%s)
GROUP BY COALESCE(o.grandparent_org_id, o.org_id), COALESCE(o.grandparent_org_name, o.org_name)
)
SELECT COALESCE(c.dim0_id, p.dim0_id) AS dim0_id, COALESCE(c.dim0_label, p.dim0_label) AS dim0_label, c.value AS current_value, p.value AS prior_value,
       (c.value - p.value) / NULLIF(p.value, 0) AS value
FROM cur c FULL OUTER JOIN pri p ON COALESCE(c.dim0_id::text, %s) = COALESCE(p.dim0_id::text, %s)
ORDER BY value DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10

WHERE s.data_source = ANY(%s) AND s.mo_offset = ANY(%s) AND p.market_subcategory IN (SELECT DISTINCT market_subcategory FROM products WHERE brand_flag = 1)

)
SELECT n.dim0_id AS dim0_id, n.dim0_label AS dim0_label,
       n.value AS numerator, d.value AS denominator,

FROM num n LEFT JOIN den d ON COALESCE(n.jk0::text, %s) = COALESCE(d.jk0::text, %s)

)
SELECT COALESCE(c.dim0_id, p.dim0_id) AS dim0_id, COALESCE(c.dim0_label, p.dim0_label) AS dim0_label, c.value AS current_value, p.value AS prior_value,

SELECT COALESCE(o.grandparent_org_id, o.org_id) AS dim0_id, COALESCE(o.grandparent_org_name, o.org_name) AS dim0_label, s.period_qtr AS dim1_id, s.period_qtr AS dim1_label, SUM(s.pack_units) AS value
FROM sales s
JOIN organizations o ON o.org_id = s.org_id
WHERE s.data_source = ANY(%s) AND s.brand_flag = 1 AND s.period_qtr = ANY(%s) AND COALESCE(o.is_340b, 0) = 0
GROUP BY COALESCE(o.grandparent_org_id, o.org_id), COALESCE(o.grandparent_org_name, o.org_name), s.period_qtr, s.period_qtr
ORDER BY value DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 5

results.question: Who are my top 3 accounts this quarter?

plan.interpretation: "This quarter" interpreted as the current calendar quarter (2026-Q3). "Top accounts" interpreted as highest paid volume (pack units).

results.sql:
SELECT COALESCE(o.grandparent_org_id, o.org_id) AS dim0_id, COALESCE(o.grandparent_org_name, o.org_name) AS dim0_label, SUM(s.pack_units) AS value
FROM sales s
JOIN organizations o ON o.org_id = s.org_id
WHERE s.data_source = ANY(%s) AND s.brand_flag = 1 AND s.period_qtr = ANY(%s)
GROUP BY COALESCE(o.grandparent_org_id, o.org_id), COALESCE(o.grandparent_org_name, o.org_name)
ORDER BY value DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 3

results.question: Show me those same accounts by month

plan.interpretation: Freezing the cohort to the same 3 accounts from the previous query and breaking down by month within Q3 2026.

results.sql:
SELECT COALESCE(o.grandparent_org_id, o.org_id) AS dim0_id, COALESCE(o.grandparent_org_name, o.org_name) AS dim0_label, s.period_mo AS dim1_id, s.period_mo AS dim1_label, SUM(s.pack_units) AS value
FROM sales s
JOIN organizations o ON o.org_id = s.org_id
WHERE s.data_source = ANY(%s) AND s.brand_flag = 1 AND s.period_qtr = ANY(%s) AND COALESCE(o.grandparent_org_id, o.org_id) = ANY(%s)
GROUP BY COALESCE(o.grandparent_org_id, o.org_id), COALESCE(o.grandparent_org_name, o.org_name), s.period_mo, s.period_mo
ORDER BY value DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 5001
